prompt:
Image 1 is a flat lay of a Lacrosse kit, photographed from the front.

Photograph THAT SAME KIT from the BACK — the same garments, turned over:
- the shirt, laid flat and face DOWN, so its back is what you see
- the shorts below it, also turned so their back is what you see
EXACTLY ONE of each. No socks, no shoes, no ball, nothing else in the frame.

Everything carries over from image 1 unchanged: the same colours, the same fabric, the
same cut, the same collar, and above all the SAME PANELS AND
TRIM — a stripe, a panel or a piping that exists on the front continues around to the
back exactly as the garment's construction would carry it. Nothing is added that image 1
does not have, and nothing that image 1 has quietly disappears.

SLEEVES: this is the same garment as image 1, so it has exactly the same sleeves. If the
shirt in image 1 has short sleeves, this one has short sleeves and is NOT a sleeveless
vest or a tank top. If image 1 is sleeveless, this one is sleeveless. Look at image 1 and
copy what is there.

THE KIT — these are settled decisions, not suggestions. Do not substitute anything.
- shirt: CHARCOAL sleeveless women's lacrosse jersey with a V-neck and a TONAL pattern of darker charcoal diagonal stripes on each SIDE PANEL. The club crest — the orange fox head in its dark hexagon — sits CENTRED ON THE CHEST on the body's midline, and the number 22 sits large and CENTRED directly below it in WHITE with a BLACK OUTLINE. A small white maker's mark sits at the upper chest on one side. NO sleeves, NO shoulder pads under it, no player name, no club name, no sponsor. BACK (not visible in any photograph — a decision from the order form): the number 22 large and centred across the shoulders in white with a black outline.
- shorts: A CHARCOAL LACROSSE KILT — a short wrap skirt to mid-thigh with a pleated overlap, worn over fitted charcoal shorts. Its panels, its hem marks (the small club fox crest and the small maker's mark it carries) and every other detail are exactly as the athlete's own kit photograph shows them. NOT plain shorts — the women's game wears the kilt. (The navy shorts in photo3 are her everyday training clothes, not the match kit.)
- socks: Plain low white ankle socks, exactly as the training photograph shows them — low enough that her lower legs are bare below the kilt in the match photograph.
- equipment: PROTECTIVE GOGGLES over the eyes: a BLACK frame with DARK wire cage bars across the eyes and a grey strap with small printed branding around the head, exactly as photo2.png shows them. The women's game has NO helmet, NO cage helmet and NO gloves: never draw either. A CROSSE (lacrosse stick) with a GREY COMPOSITE shaft wrapped along its length in worn OFF-WHITE grip tape and an open strung head — hers exactly as photo2.png shows it. A plain YELLOW lacrosse ball — not visible in any photograph, so the ball is the deliberate plain default. The same goggles, crosse and ball appear in every generated frame that calls for them.
- For footwear the photographs did not
  answer, so use exactly this and nothing else:
a charcoal sleeveless lacrosse jersey with contrasting trim at the collar and armholes, a matching charcoal lacrosse KILT (a short pleated skirt) with fitted shorts beneath it, and protective GOGGLES over the eyes — the women's game has NO helmet, NO cage, NO shoulder pads and NO gloves. The kit fits properly and is clean and well kept.
CONSISTENT ACROSS THE WHOLE SET — three of these frames sit side by side on one card, so
these must be identical in every shot and are not open to interpretation:
- Socks are charcoal, matching the kit. Never white, never a different colour.
- Equipment: a plain white lacrosse ball and a plain unbranded crosse. The same one in every shot.
- Footwear: plain black lacrosse cleats with a studded outsole. NOT sneakers. The same pair in every shot, clean and unmarked.
- Where an item above is described from the athlete's own photographs, any manufacturer's
  logo it genuinely carries stays on it — that is their real clothing.
- footwear came from the sport default, so
  this is PLAIN and UNBRANDED: no swoosh, no three
  stripes, no cat, no jumpman, no trefoil, no wordmark. Do not add a brand device to a
  garment nobody supplied.
- The club crest sits CENTRED HIGH ON THE CHEST, directly above the number and below the collar, about a hand's width across, exactly where and how large the kit photograph shows it. That position is settled and is the same in every frame.

THE BACK OF THE SHIRT carries the squad number 22, plus whatever else the
kit description above explicitly gives it — and nothing more. Add no mark the description
does not name.
NEVER any lettering: no club name, no player name, no sponsor, no word of any kind.
Nothing sits inside, on top of or overlapping the numerals — a badge, if the description
calls for one, is small, clear of the number, and the right way round.

Hard requirements:
- Everything is BRAND NEW and immaculate: no dirt, no scuffs, no wear, no sweat marks.
- Flat lay from directly overhead. No mannequin, no person, no body, no hanger, no rail.
- The same plain light grey surface and the same even lighting as image 1.
- No text of any kind beyond the number, no labels, no neck tag, no watermark.
- Sharp throughout, photographic, print quality. Square image.
